name: compose-security-opt-disabled
attack_scenario: With seccomp:unconfined a container can call dangerous syscalls (keyctl, ptrace, unshare, bpf) used in known runc/kernel breakout chains that the default seccomp profile blocks.
negative_test_hint: run "unshare --user --pid --fork" inside the container and assert the syscall is denied under the default seccomp/AppArmor profile

exemplar.explanation: seccomp:unconfined removes the syscall filter, apparmor:unconfined drops the MAC profile, label:disable turns off SELinux confinement, and no-new-privileges:false re-enables setuid privilege escalation; each strips a layer that blocks known container-breakout chains. Keeping the default profiles and no-new-privileges:true confines a compromised process inside the container.
